Description: A unique ID that identifies a unique building from the survey
District where the building is located
Municipality where the building is located
Ward Number in which the building is located
Number of floors that the building had before the earthquake
Age of the building (in years)
Plinth area of the building (in square feet)
Height of the building before the earthquake (in feet)
Surface condition of the land in which the building is built
Type of foundation used in the building
Type of roof used in the building
Ground floor type
Type of construction used in other floors (except ground floor and roof)
Position of the building
Building plan configuration
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Adobe/Mud
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Mud Mortar - Stone
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Stone
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Cement Mortar - Stone
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Mud Mortar - Brick
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Cement Mortar - Brick
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Timber
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of Bamboo
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of RC (Non Engineered)
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of RC (Engineered)
Flag variable that indicates if the superstructure of the building is made of any other material
Damage grade assigned to the building by the surveyor after assessment (TARGET)
